text: Mai starts at the architecture firm on June 3rd. She's nervous about the commute more than the work itself.
Efua's flying to Accra sometime next week to see her grandmother. Long haul with a toddler, so she's dreading it.
Arjun got the promotion! Team lead from the start of next month. I should send him something to congratulate him.
Dana and Kemal are off to Japan for three weeks over the summer. Their first proper holiday since the wedding.
Ibrahim's cat Pepper is at the vet again with kidney trouble. He sounded exhausted on the phone this morning.
Need to pick up flea treatment and a new lead before Saturday.

Imani is retiring at the end of the month after twenty-two years at the library. Her leaving do is May 14 at the Crown. Don't forget to sign the card that's going round. Her husband Stefan is planning to take her on a cruise round the Norwegian fjords in early June, which she's been wanting to do for years. She says she's going to miss the regulars, especially the little kids at Saturday story time.
Rana has a new puppy, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. She's already obsessed and sending photos every hour.
Ignacio's last day at the bank was Friday. He hasn't lined anything up yet but seems relieved more than anything.
Tariq mentioned his brother Juan is moving to Lisbon in early March for a job with a shipping company.
Remind me to ask Kwame how the first week at the hospital went. He started on 9/14 and I haven't heard a peep.
Stefan and Ana have cancelled the Iceland trip. Ana's dad is unwell, so they're staying put for now.
Eilidh loves birdwatching. She's been saving up for a decent pair of binoculars, which might be a good birthday idea.

Aaliyah has an interview with the airline on October 28th. Cabin crew, which she's wanted to do since she was a kid. She's terrified of the group exercise part, and her mum keeps telling her to have a backup plan, which isn't helping. If it goes well there's a second round in mid November and training would start in January. I should send her a good luck text the night before.
Elif's dog Rolo turns one on November 2nd and she's genuinely throwing him a party. Apparently there will be a cake made of liver.
Ioana's moving to the Manchester office in the new year. Her husband Nasser isn't thrilled about it.
Call Rafael this weekend. His mum had her hip operation yesterday and he's been back and forth to the hospital all week.
Olga said her daughter just got into vet school. Starts sometime in September.
Patrick Baker is our new manager from Monday. Seems decent, very keen on spreadsheets.

Matteo's off to Australia for a month from December 10. Twenty-three hours of flying each way. He's asked if I can water his plants, and I said yes. He's stopping in Singapore for two nights on the way out to see his old flatmate Reza, then Sydney, then a week driving up to Brisbane. Back sometime around January 8. Keys are under the blue pot.
Reza was a bit low today. His contract ends at the end of the month and nothing has come through yet. I should check in with him sometime next week.
Florin finally got his driving licence back after the move. He's starting as a delivery driver on Thursday.
Vikram's parents are visiting from Pune for most of the summer. He's slightly panicking about the spare room.
Caroline brought her old greyhound, Duke, to the park. He's thirteen now and very slow, but still steals everyone's sandwiches.
Booked the flights for Lisbon, leaving on April 7th and back on the 15th. Need to sort travel insurance.
Amara and her partner Isla are adopting a rescue cat sometime next week. They want an older one, nothing too chaotic.
Thabo is leaving the school at Christmas after eleven years. Everyone's chipping in for a gift; I must give Caroline twenty quid by Friday.
Mai told me her brother Arjun has been made redundant. Meeting with HR on 11/3 to sort the package. She's worried about him.
Efua's cat had kittens! Five of them. She's keeping one and trying to rehome the rest by the end of November.
Don't forget Kemal's birthday on July 22. He's been dropping hints about a new hiking backpack.
Dana is starting a PhD in marine biology in early January. She's moving up to Aberdeen for it.
Ibrahim got the job at the airport! Starts November 6th, night shifts to begin with. Send him a message to say well done.
Imani said her nephew Kwame is doing his ground school exams for his pilot licence sometime next month.

Lunch with Rana. She's vegetarian now, and she's started learning Portuguese before her trip to Brazil in the spring. Her boss is letting her take five weeks off, which is unheard of. She's flying into São Paulo on March 12 and travelling north for most of April. Her flatmate Elif is looking after her rabbit, Clover, while she's away. I really want to hear about the trip when she's back.
Pick up Grandad's prescription, then the post office before five.

Ignacio's tortoise, Señor Lento, has gone missing again. Third time this year. He thinks the neighbours' fence has a gap. His kids put posters up on every lamppost on the street this afternoon, and Ignacio's offering a reward of a box of fancy chocolates. Last time he turned up two gardens down eating lettuce. Must keep an eye on our garden too.
Tariq's wife is expecting their second in March. They've just found out it's a girl.
Text Juan on Wednesday to wish him luck. It's his first day at the new agency and he was really anxious about it when we spoke.
Stefan's mum retires on June 30th. The family's planning a surprise trip to Croatia for her, and he's asked me not to mention it to anyone.
Ana is allergic to cats, so the weekend at Eilidh's is probably off unless Mittens goes to a sitter.
Aaliyah's hamster died on Sunday. She's taking it harder than she expected. Might pop round with some cake.

Elif mentioned she's been offered a promotion to head of design, but it means relocating to Berlin by the end of the year. She hasn't decided yet. Her partner Ioana works remotely, so that's not the issue; it's more about leaving her dad, who's been unwell since the spring. She asked me to keep it to myself for now. I should ask how she's leaning sometime next week.
Nasser is into vintage watches. Has a small collection, mostly Seikos from the seventies.
Rafael's flight back from Bogotá got delayed by two days, so he missed his sister's graduation on May 20. He's gutted.
Thinking about a long weekend somewhere warm in early March. Maybe Seville.
Olga's dog Bruno needs surgery on his knee on 12/5. It's expensive and she's quite stressed about it. Remind me to ask how it went that evening.
Patrick and his wife are celebrating their twenty-fifth anniversary on August 9th with a trip to Venice.
Matteo said his new job at the studio is going well. He's already been asked to lead a small project.
Reza's daughter Isla starts nursery on Monday. He's more nervous than she is, apparently.

Florin and his girlfriend split up last week. He's staying at his cousin's for a bit. Should give him a ring at the weekend. He said they'd been arguing for months, mostly about whether to move to Bucharest so he could be near his parents. His cousin's dog, a huge husky called Zeus, sleeps on his feet every night, which he claims is the only good part of all this.
Vikram's leaving drinks are next Thursday. He's off to Singapore for a two-year posting. I'm getting the first round, obviously.
Caroline's parrot, Mr Biggles, is fifty this year. Older than both of us. She wants to do something for his birthday on 6/18.
Amara is cycling the coast-to-coast for charity sometime in the summer. She's training every weekend and asked if I'd sponsor her.
Nothing much to note. Coffee was good, weather was awful.
Isla said Thabo, aka Tibs, has been made deputy head from January. He's thrilled but already worried about the extra workload.

Mai and her husband are off to Vietnam over Christmas to see his family in Hanoi. First time she'll meet his grandmother. I should lend her my big suitcase before she goes, probably the week of December 14. She's also asked for tips on long flights, so I'll send her my packing list and the name of that neck pillow. His mum apparently cooks for days when guests arrive.
Kwame's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is in Kumasi sometime early next month and he's flying out with his mum.

Efua's sister Dana is getting married in Ghana next August. Efua's maid of honour and already stressing about the speech. Their mum is handling most of the planning from Accra, and Efua's flying out three weeks early to help. Dana's fiancé Kwame proposed on a beach last Easter, so they wanted the wedding near the sea too. Must ask Efua for the exact date so I can book leave before the summer rush.
Kemal's new kitten is called Pasha. Tiny, ginger, and terrified of the hoover.

Got the offer letter. Start date is the 1st, so I've got two weeks to finish everything here and hand over. Need to tell Ibrahim before the team meeting on Wednesday. He'll be fine about it, but I'd rather he heard it from me than from HR. Also need to return the laptop and badge on my last day, and maybe organise a small farewell lunch for the team sometime the week after next. The new place wants me in the office three days a week.
